summary.subject: Processes: Os.run in the foreground with the program's streams, Os.output for one value, Os.start/wait/kill/stop/pid in the background in a process group of its own, Os.openPipe, Os.which over the run's own PATH; a signal's status is 128 + n; the ant command holds back SIGINT and SIGQUIT while Os.run waits and passes one on when the child dies of it (ant.WithForeground), keeps an ignored SIGINT ignored, and ends by the signal that interrupted the run; stdin is read only on demand, so a child gets the terminal's input; children read handles through copies that end with them, a pipe end handed over keeps its context reads, a host's non-file stdin is read one at a time, and a stopped run writes nothing more into the host's writers; fuzzers and tests for all of it; TODO drops two items
